{{Quote|Listen, I'm only the first interviewer. If you don't cooperate&hellip;well, you've heard about Wookiees and arms.|Alliance interrogator to an Imperial prisoner|<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>}}
'''Interrogators''' were military specialists tasked with extracting information from prisoners. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed interrogators.

==Imperial interrogators==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used interrogators extensively during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE" /> Both [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] maintained [[Interrogation (Imperial Intelligence)|specific]] [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|branches]] dedicated to interrogating prisoners.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Imperial interrogators made extensive use of "facilitation," which was their term for "[[Torture/Legends|torture]]."<ref name="ROE" />

==Alliance interrogators==
Interrogators in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] differed from their Imperial counterparts in the methods they used, and did not employ torture as they knew it was ineffective in providing accurate information.<ref name="ROE" /> [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] had a [[Interrogation (Alliance Intelligence)|branch]] dedicated to interrogation,<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] also maintained a cadre of interrogators. Alliance interrogators relied on subtle methods of interrogation, such as intimidation, perception manipulation, sleep deprivation, and telepathic probing if available. [[Hortek]]s serving in SpecForce were generally employed as interrogators.<ref name="ROE" />

Unlike Alliance Intelligence interrogators, who had time and facilities to work with, SpecForce interrogators were generally dropped into a location and given a short amount of time to get information from a prisoner. Among SpecForce interrogators tricks was the use of "acceleration," by making the prisoner believe that a longer period of time had elapsed. This was achieved by having a series of interviews, followed by a short sleep, followed by an early breakfast and morning interview. Interrogators maintained the illusion by using a [[wash-up kit]] and [[portable uniform fresher]] to appear freshly groomed. To the prisoner, it would seem as if a period of twenty-four to thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] had passed, when in reality, only twelve hours had elapsed. Another method was simulated torture, where the prisoner was made to believe that another captive was being tortured in the adjoining room. The interrogator would cultivate a sense of false camaraderie with the prisoner in order to draw out information in exchange for safety.<ref name="ROE" />
